kind: timed-still animatic, not finished character animation

beats.title: Hold standing
lines: Right hand rests over the left.
Eyes down. Feet planted.
Keep the original drawing’s proportions.

beats.title: Release the hands
lines: Release the fingers first.
Separate and lower the forearms.
Keep the torso upright until the hands clear.

beats.title: Hinge into the bow
lines: Lead from the hips; keep the feet planted.
Hands travel toward the knees.
Draw the cloth compression and changing overlaps.

beats.title: Hold bowing
lines: Back flat and horizontal. Head in line.
Hands settle onto the knees.
Correct the back shape in this reference.

beats.title: Rise with control
lines: Release the hands from the knees.
Bring the torso upright without a body-wide scale.
Preserve the weight and planted foot contacts.

beats.title: Replace the hands
lines: Place the left hand on the chest.
Then settle the right hand over it.
Keep wrist and finger contact readable.

beats.title: Settle into the hold
lines: Return to the opening drawing.
Allow a small, calm settling movement.
Review the loop at normal playback speed.
